title: Samsung to inject $1 billion into Nvidia- and KKR-backed AI infrastructure firm
summary_full: Samsung Electronics and its five affiliates are investing $1 billion in KKR-launched Helix as the group expands its push into global AI infrastructure.
summary_public: Samsung Electronics and its five affiliates are investing $1 billion in KKR-launched Helix as the group expands its push into global AI infrastructure.
